SELECT s.id AS store_id, s.code AS store_code, s.name AS store_name, s.platform, s.marketplace, s.owner_id, u.nickname AS owner_name, s.status FROM ecom_store s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.owner_id
(s.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND s.platform = #{platform}
AND (s.owner_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_store_member m WHERE m.store_id = s.id AND m.user_id = #{userId}))
ORDER BY s.status DESC, s.id

SELECT m.id, m.store_id, m.user_id, m.member_role, m.remark, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_time, u.username, u.nickname, s.name AS store_name FROM ecom_store_member m JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = m.store_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.store_id IN #{id} ORDER BY m.store_id, m.id
